div.div:
Why this is the only diagram with grade branches
render() is the one caller that passes a non-null grade.
layoutPagesFromHeaders() and decodePageToRgba() both pass
nullptr, so on those paths every "grade set?" is decided
before it is asked — which is why their diagrams are shorter
rather than repetitions of this one.

div.div:
The two Scaler overloads are different calls
Both buffered branches converge on scale(buffer, path, width).
The no-margin, no-grade branch uses scale(path, width) instead,
which never materialises a PixelBuffer at all.
